items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Mrs. Turner bought me a toy drum, and I'd go to church with her with the drum... I was staying with Mr. and Mrs. Turner at that time.

ctx.x: But yet and still, you're supposed to be, in one sense, the ambassador, you know.

We loved our music, but there are certain elements that hate musicians and entertainers. Certain elements think that you just come in there to take a girl. Some young ladies love to be with an entertainer. He's fun and some of them flashy dressers, you know, and it makes them feel good. And then there's the guys (Unintelligible) if you don't wait outside and hit you with a baseball bat and beat you up, might kill you. You're going to spread a campaign, you know, go to the man, get you fired. Oh, it's mean and yet…

It's like when Mrs. Turner died, I was out trying to find, before I went to work that night, trying to find to beg the clubowner for (unintelligible) an advance so I could get my little fix and everybody's beating a path to my door to tell me Mrs. Turner died. I finally got on home. I had to get back to work. And I had to work. So, I worked that night though because it was my heart was breaking, house (unintelligible) but that's the way it is, you know.
